selection_policy: Directly relevant online/open-set/uncertainty/robustness alarm-flood methods found in the three literature-expansion rounds; status is evidence-backed, not inferred from publication date.

status_semantics.verified: Official or author-equivalent implementation reproduces a representative paper result on the same dataset and protocol within declared tolerance.
status_semantics.partial: A callable independent implementation and synthetic invariants exist, but official artifact/data/table closure is incomplete.
status_semantics.missing: The paper is registered as a frontier target but no faithful callable implementation exists yet.
